interface.appLanguageHint: Changes OpenNOW's interface language. English is used for untranslated strings.
interface.accentColorHint: Applies the selected accent across the standard desktop UI and persists between launches.
interface.hideStreamOverlayButtonsHint: Hide microphone, fullscreen, and end-session buttons while streaming.
interface.showStatsOnStreamLaunchHint: Automatically show the stats overlay when a new stream starts.
interface.hideServerSelectorHint: Skip the free-tier server selection dialog and always launch with OpenNOW's default routing.
interface.showAntiAfkIndicatorHint: Show the ANTI-AFK ON badge while Anti-AFK is enabled during streaming.
interface.autoFullScreenHint: Automatically enter fullscreen when connecting to or starting a session.
interface.escapeExitsFullscreenHint: When enabled, pressing Escape will exit fullscreen. When disabled (default), Escape is forwarded to the game while the mouse is pointer-locked.
interface.discordRichPresenceHint: Show the game you are streaming as your Discord activity, including elapsed time.
interface.controllerModeLibraryHint: Replace the desktop library/settings navigation with the controller-first layout only when controller mode is enabled.
interface.controllerUiSoundsHint: Play subtle move, open, and back sounds inside controller mode only.
interface.controllerBackgroundAnimationsHint: Show animated background visuals on controller-mode loading screens only.
interface.autoLoadControllerLibraryHint: Automatically open the controller library at startup when controller mode is enabled.
interface.posterSizeHint: Adjusts game posters in real time across the library and controller views.
interface.sessionElapsedCounterHint: Enable or disable the live session elapsed counter while streaming.
interface.sessionTimerReappearHint: How often the session timer pops back up while streaming (0 disables repeats).
interface.sessionTimerVisibleTimeHint: How long the session timer stays visible each time it appears.
interface.sessionTimerDisabledHint: Disabling the session elapsed counter stops the live elapsed timer from rendering at all. Remaining playtime indicators stay unchanged.

nativeStreamer.title: Native Streamer
nativeStreamer.nativeStreamingHint: Native streaming is experimental and may have platform-specific bugs, glitches, or fallbacks to Chromium/WebRTC. Enable it only if you are comfortable testing the GStreamer-based desktop streamer for new sessions.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptBody: The native streamer is still experimental. OpenNOW shortcuts do not work while the native streamer window has focus.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptNewSessions: Native streaming applies to new sessions only.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptShortcuts: Overlay, exit, fullscreen, stats, and other shortcuts will not trigger inside the native streamer window.
nativeStreamer.enablePromptAltTab: Alt+Tab back into the OpenNOW window to exit the stream or use OpenNOW shortcuts.
nativeStreamer.statusDefaultHint: OpenNOW will check the bundled GStreamer streamer when this tab opens.
nativeStreamer.runtimeDefaultHint: Packaged Windows/macOS builds auto-detect a bundled runtime next to the native streamer. Linux uses distro packages.
nativeStreamer.linuxRuntimeHint: Linux AppImage/private GStreamer bundling is intentionally not used by default because VAAPI/V4L2/Vulkan plugins must match the host distro and GPU driver stack. .deb packages declare Debian/Ubuntu dependencies automatically.
nativeStreamer.videoPathDefaultHint: OpenNOW will show the active hardware decode path after GStreamer is detected.
nativeStreamer.directxBackendHint: Applies to the next native streamer process. Auto uses the fastest default path; choose DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 to force a specific Windows renderer.
nativeStreamer.framePacingHint: Lowest Latency avoids G-Sync pacing and is best for mouse feel. Smooth G-Sync can reduce tearing, but may cap rendering to the monitor refresh rate.

androidStreamInput.stream_input_choose_at_launch_body: A keyboard or mouse is connected. Use native touch for this game, or switch to keyboard and mouse?

androidStreamInput.stream_menu_shortcut_press_keys: Press the key combination you want to use. Modifier-only and controller buttons are ignored.

androidSetup.setup_gfn_subtitle: OpenNOW is another way to use GeForce NOW, not a separate cloud gaming service.
androidSetup.setup_gfn_boundaries_title: What OpenNOW can and cannot do
androidSetup.setup_gfn_client_point: OpenNOW is an independent, alternative client. Your games, membership and cloud sessions still come from GeForce NOW.
androidSetup.setup_gfn_servers_point: %1$s controls the servers, supported games, availability and membership benefits.
androidSetup.setup_gfn_queues_point: OpenNOW cannot add servers, bypass queues or reduce queue times. Paid queue priority also comes from your GFN provider.
androidSetup.setup_gfn_checking_body: An NVIDIA or provider account alone is not enough to play. You must also activate at least the Free GFN membership.
androidSetup.setup_gfn_missing_body: %1$s says this account cannot start gameplay. Activate the Free tier (no payment method required) or choose a paid membership, then check again.
androidSetup.setup_gfn_unverified_body: The provider did not return a definite answer. You can retry, or finish anyway if this is a temporary connection problem.
androidSetup.launch_no_gfn_plan_body: GeForce NOW refused the session because this account does not have a current playable plan. Activate Free or choose a paid membership, then sign in to OpenNOW again.
androidSetup.settings_static_outlines_desc: Add thin outlines to game artwork, the top bar, and horizontal navigation. Turn off for lighter glass without disabling animated border effects.
androidSetup.settings_category_bug_reports_summary: Track reports and reply to the release team
androidSetup.bug_report_inbox_body: See progress and continue the conversation for reports sent from this installation.
androidSetup.bug_report_inbox_empty: Reports sent from this device will appear here with updates from the release team.
androidSetup.bug_report_inbox_reply_hint: Add more information or answer a question
androidSetup.bug_report_inbox_terms: I agree to use bug reporting for good-faith product feedback. Abusive, spam, or knowingly false reports may result in a reporting ban.
androidSetup.bug_report_inbox_closed: This conversation is closed. If the release team reopens it, replies will become available again.
androidSetup.bug_report_describe_english_from_setting: Describe the issue in English. Sanitized diagnostics are attached.
androidSetup.bug_report_media_note: Optional media is sent with your diagnostics. Up to four files, 10 MiB each and 20 MiB total.
androidSetup.bug_report_consent_body: Review what will be sent, then agree to continue to the report form.
androidSetup.bug_report_terms_consent: I understand what will be uploaded and agree to the bug reporting terms. Abusive, spam, or knowingly false reports may result in a reporting ban.
